fields.name: DialogId
fields.evidence: Server: EoCServer.dll+0x846050 (esv::notification::System query lambda over esv::dialog::FailedPrivateDialogJoinAttemptOneFrameComponent, stride 0x28) copies the whole one-frame (u32 +0, Guid +8, Guid +0x18) into a notification request with variant tag 0xF; tag 15 of ls::Variant<esv::notification::System::...> is FailedPrivateDialogJoinAttemptNotification (variant type list in the lambda's IndexedStorage name). Client: the notification dispatcher bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 case 0xF calls this component's creator bg3.exe+0x2DF14F0 and stores request +0 (u32) here. The one-frame's +0 is DialogId (key of PrivacySystem's map, first argument of ecl::LSDialogsProtocol::SendFailedJoinDialog).
